def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,5)]
    top=min(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    bottom=max(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    left=min(c for row in grid for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5)
    right=max(c for row in grid for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5)
    mr=(top+bottom)//2; mc=(left+right)//2
    for r in range(top+1,bottom):
        for c in range(left+1,right):
            # each marker fills its corresponding quadrant and its diagonal opposite
            match=next(v for rr,cc,v in marks if ((rr<top)==(r<=mr)) == ((cc<left)==(c<=mc))) if False else None
            # colors at outside corner map to same-side inner quadrant, plus opposite
            vals=[]
            for rr,cc,v in marks:
                top_side=rr<top; left_side=cc<left
                if (r<=mr)==top_side and (c<=mc)==left_side or (r<=mr)!=top_side and (c<=mc)!=left_side:
                    vals.append(v)
            out[r][c]=vals[0]
    return out
